Tessa / Markus — I reviewed ProcureCo's asks and the attached portal spec. High level below, with suggested operational steps:
1) PO routing (cost center + GL code): we can accept this, but we must treat mapping as a one-way ingest — Redwood will not be liable for downstream GL reconciliation. Proposed contract language: add a short limitation in the Order Form (new section 4.2): "Vendor will populate cost center and GL code fields to the best of its ability based on customer-provided mapping. Customer remains responsible for accounting reconciliation and code accuracy."

2) Signatory requirement: rather than require a domestic in-person signatory, Legal recommends we accept e-signature with delegation confirmation from a finance executive. Suggested approach: add an execution block to the Order Form that allows for either (a) an authorized domestic signatory, or (b) an electronic signature from an identified Finance delegate with title and email confirmed via portal metadata. This avoids delaying onboarding for countries where domestic signatory travel is a blocker.

3) Insurance & evidence: ProcureCo wants COI and W9 uploaded. Confirm Redwood's minimums (we typically accept COI limits of 1M/2M). Ask vendor to upload COI naming Redwood as Additional Insured and a completed W9. If ProcureCo requires higher limits, raise to insurance@redwood and we'll review.

4) Execution workflow: If the portal cannot capture signatory metadata, propose DocuSign fallback (we already have an integration). Include an annotation in the portal record linking to DocuSign execution URL.

Operational asks:
- Tessa: ask ProcureCo to accept the limited Order Form language and confirm preferred execution path (portal e-sign vs DocuSign).
- Markus / Sales Ops: flag deal DEAL-9082 for "portal-exception" so legal can track completion.

I've attached my annotated redline (MSA_redlines_kp.pdf) with the proposed 4.2 insertion and a sample Exec block. Happy to talk through with Jill if needed — I can join a short call tomorrow.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
